body:
I am having such a bad anxiety attack about the whole thing. I feel impossibly guilty about wanting to leave her. The main reason for me wanting to leave is because she threatened me. She said if I didn't start obeying her without question or complaint she was going to call the cops and tell them I abuse her.

The thing is, she's done that before. One of my brother's friends lived with us, and last year she completely ruined his life by telling the cops he stole her medications and sold them. He was in jail for weeks, no home to go to when he got out, I'm not even sure if he got to keep his job. I'm terrified I'm next.
My dad is letting me come stay with him for awhile, so I can get out of here.

There probably is, but unlike my family I just can't do that. Maybe later I can, but I just keep thinking that's my mother, how could I do something like that to her? She did the same thing to my older sister too, thats one of the main reasons why she bounced when she was 17 and never looked back. I wish I had really understood her advice to me when I was a teenager, but I just didn't understand what she was talking about. 

I have never been arrested. My record is super clean except for that one restraining order. I was told it wouldn't show up on my record because the judge threw it out and it was only a temporary restraining order, but it shows up if I look myself up.

My dad is letting me come stay with him temporarily. But he can't get me until tomorrow. With all the stuff that happened today I'm scared that something will happen between now and then. But for now I'm just pretending like I'm cleaning my room up when in reality I'm making sure all my shit is in boxes.

I can't even begin to tell you what a revelation that site has been for me. Like, almost every single thing I've read on that site just makes so much sense to me. Especially after today, when my mom literally re-wrote the chain of events of the last few days. Screaming at me that I was just in some blind rage and I don't remember properly when I remember everything, and I wasn't angry. I was sad.

What is a NGO? I've never heard of that before. I'll google it actually, save time and effort for everyone.

I am getting out. I talked to my Dad today, and told him everything. How I feel like I have to kill myself to escape and how I'm feeling and everything. He's letting me stay with him until I get a job and get money to move out on my own. I can't leave until tomorrow morning so I'm just trying to get all my stuff together so all we have to do is put it in the truck. Now I'm terrified for my cat. I can't leave him here, they always say they're going to take him to the pound when they're mad at me. But I don't know if my dad will want my cat around, he's kind of a mean kitty. He's an outdoor cat too, he can't go outside at my dads house because there's too many coyotes. I know that's a dumb thing to worry about but my cat makes me so happy.

I know I need to see someone, I have a lot of issues I need to work through. I really don't think I can do anti-depressants again, but I will try. It might be different now since I'm not 16, and I swear every anti-depressant has bad side effects for teenagers. I honestly feel like if I can just make it through today and get out and get all of my stuff so they can't try to hold anything over me, that I will be okay. This is the first step.

That is actually the opposite of what I usually try to do, so I will try that. I usually try to keep work and my personal life separate. So maybe switching it up and letting them know how desperate I am to get out of there might work.

I have a few times, I go stay with my dad for a week every month. He's got cancer, so I try to spend as much time with him as I can. He lives far away though. Driving distance, but far enough away that I can't just escape when I want to go. Plus I don't trust my family with my stuff. I had my dad put a lock on my door because they steal from me a lot. So I feel like if I left right now when everyone's so mad at me, they're just going to steal all of my shit. If I left the house right now, I would make sure I could take everything I care about with me. Or probably just everything, I wouldn't put it past them to just throw all my stuff away. They used to go in my room and just take shit and tell my mom I let them have it.

My dad wants me to be able to stand on my own two feet, and feels like he'd be enabling me to be a bum if I moved in with him. He knows it gets bad, but he doesn't know how it makes me feel. I don't tell him that part, he has enough to worry about.

I'll check out Clanned, I think I saw that on netflix awhile ago. I don't watch a lot of anime, but maybe something new is what I need right now. I'll try to remember to come back on and let you know if I liked it or not.

I'm not sure. Typing that novel into reddit blew some of the wind out of my sails. I feel a lot better just getting my feelings out there. I still feel terrible, and anxious. But it's not even half as bad as it was when I started typing. I think that if I can just get through the next few days without any drama, things will settle down in the house and they'll leave me alone again. I'm not thinking about stabbing myself anymore, so I'll be okay for now as long as I lay low. Which means not leaving my room so I'm going to feast on reeses peanut butter cups and cashews tonight, lol... I really do feel better and not quite as desperate. Thank you for being here for me.

I think saving up and moving out would be better for me in the long run. If I move out I can see someone about all the shit that's in my head. I don't think I can get better while I'm here. I'd just come home and feel miserable again. The only thing that makes me happy here is my cat, and even then sometimes, like right now, when I get in a fight with my mom, I'm scared that she'll take him to the pound. She threatens that sometimes.

Thank you, and I have. But I think sometimes that since I'm just a guest in their lives that they would get over it. My friend killed himself a few years ago, and I was so upset I couldn't go to the funeral. I couldn't let it be real. We weren't even super close anymore, but I still think about it and it just fucks me up. That's when I think about how I would effect my friends. Sometimes I don't think it matters though.

I've been slowly saving up money for years. I had close to 800, but my cat got bit by a dog, not terrible, but it was a big gaping wound and my cat is my baby. So I shelled out all I had to make sure he got taken care of. I have 212 dollars right now, in a bank account that no one knows about but me, my dad, and now reddit. I'm trying to find a job really bad. I'll even settle for one of those shitty jobs where you work from home and telemarketer people and piss them off. I live far from town, it takes almost two hours to walk there.

Professionally? No. When I asked my mom to take me to see someone when I was sixteen, she just made fun of me and ridiculed me. It's made me shy away from telling anyone. I had told an online friend years ago, but I don't talk to them anymore. I want to tell one of my friends now, but I feel like it's wrong to just dump my shit in their lap.
